response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amt_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS bal_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(amt_avg) AS avg_amount_avg, AVG(bal_avg) AS avg_balance_avg FROM acc GROUP BY region) SELECT region, avg_amount_avg, avg_balance_avg, avg_amount_avg / (SELECT AVG(avg_amount_avg) FROM reg) AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM reg WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_amount_avg) FROM reg) IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the plain average of the regional averages (each region weighted equally), not an average over accounts or transactions.

Accounts with no PRIJEM/VYDAJ transactions have a NULL amount average and are skipped in the amount average. They still count in the balance average, because balance covers all of an account's transactions.
Amounts are used as stored (unsigned) for both PRIJEM and VYDAJ, as the request says. VYBER and other types are excluded from the amount average only.
